thread:
Priya: Quick follow-up from last night's outage postmortem — I uploaded the action table to the doc (https://redwood.internal/pm/cache-thrash). Need firm owners, Jira tickets, and target dates. Rough RACI in the doc, but please confirm.
Jon: I'll own 1) cache eviction fix. I'll spin up a ticket RW-4820 and set ETA 2026-04-05. Marking myself as R. @Priya can you add this to the remediation board?
Marta: I'll take 2) synthetic long-tail seq tests. Creating RW-4821 now. Need infra creds to run larger sequences in stage. ETA 2026-04-08.
Sasha: Ack. I'll be the C for 2) and will help with test harness. Also volunteering to do 3) capacity analysis support — we should check historical tail latency across regions.
Priya: Thanks. Updated RACI draft: Jon=R for 1, Marta=R for 2, Sasha=C for 2/3, Mike=C for 5, Priya=A for coordination. If you want to change roles, reply here.
OpsBot: Created epic RW-4900 "PM: cache-thrash remediations" and linked RW-4820, RW-4821.
Jon: Quick question about 4) runbook updates — is the required change just thresholds or also the sequence for fallback? If it's both, I'll pair with @Marta on repro steps.
Marta: We need both. I'll add repro notes from my test harness run. Jon please add a short checklist to the ticket.
Priya: Adding a short checklist here so we don't lose it:
```
- [ ] RW-4820 (Jon): fix eviction logic + unit tests. ETA 2026-04-05
- [ ] RW-4821 (Marta): synthetic tests + infra runs. ETA 2026-04-08
- [ ] RW-4822 (Sasha): capacity analysis + region comparison. ETA 2026-04-10
- [ ] RW-4824 (Priya/Mike): runbook update + deploy playbook. ETA 2026-04-12
- [ ] RW-4823 (Mike): dedicated fallback cost analysis, budget ask. ETA 2026-04-12
```
Sasha: I'll open RW-4822 and link metrics dashboards. Also proposing an automated alert: eviction_rate > 0.7% for 5m -> page SRE. Should we add as an action?
Mike: I can take 5) dedicated-capacity fallback implementation but need a cost sign-off. I'll open RW-4823 for the budget analysis and cc finance. ETA 2026-04-12.
Priya: Noted. Also flagging recurring pattern — similar spikes on 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-10. I propose a recurring monthly postmortem tracker so we can catch regressions earlier. Who will steward that?
Marta: I'll steward the recurring-incident tracker and keep the timeline of patterns. Will add RW-4830 and a short SOP.
Jon: For handoffs: if anyone needs to hand an item off midway, please assign a buddy in the ticket (add "backup-owner") and ping #eng-oncall so oncall knows interim contacts.
Priya: Final ask: owners, please update Jira with precise target dates and link back to the postmortem doc. We'll do a closure/triage on the Apr 15 ops sync. Ping me if you can't meet the ETAs. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Mike: Roger, will update RW-4823 with cost breakdown by 2026-04-09.
Jon: RW-4820 created and assigned. I added a small PR checklist for review. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: RW-4820, RW-4821, RW-4822, RW-4823, RW-4830 all linked to epic RW-4900.
Priya: Awesome. We'll close the loop next sync. If anything blocks (infra quotas, secrets, or budget) call it out here and we'll escalate.
